title: Choosing a Software Case
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting choosing a software case to the software-case selection memo with objective-to-affordance-to-constraint mapping, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Map a learning objective to the specific affordance it requires before naming any tool
Select the least costly tool that affords the required action and survives the constraints
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
